title:
Selling and buying?
*Exercise to exercise*

lines.say: You're placing a deposit on a new home, but you haven't sold your current one. One wrong move can cost you 20% of the new home's price.
lines.cap: one wrong move: *20%* of the price

lines.say: That's Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty. On a 1.5 million dollar condo, it's 300,000 dollars.
The key is timing. Your buyer must exercise the option on your current home first.
Only then do you exercise the option on your new home.
Not the option date. Not completion. Exercise date to exercise date.
Get the order right, and you buy as a first-home owner, with no ABSD for citizens.

lines.stat: General info. Confirm with your lawyer

caption:
Placing a deposit on a new home before your current one is sold? One wrong move can cost you 20% of the new home's price. ⚠️

That's Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty: $300,000 on a $1.5M condo. The key is timing. Your buyer must exercise the option on your current home first. Only then do you exercise the option on your new home.

Not the option date. Not completion. Exercise date to exercise date.

Save this 👇

General information only. Confirm the timing with your conveyancing lawyer.
